scheme_name: One Time Cash Incentive towards acquiring BEd, BPEd, DTEd, PGDCA (Sainik Welfare)
other_conditions: Applicant must be registered with the Department of Sainik Welfare, Puducherry
Applicant must have obtained prior permission from the Department of Sainik Welfare, Puducherry
Application must be made within three years of discharge from service
Course/program must be from a Government‑recognized school/institution
Course/program must be one of: BEd, BPEd, DTEd, PGDCA
Application should be submitted within three months from the date of successful completion of the course
benefits_summary: Up to ₹20,000 cash is provided to eligible ex‑servicemen to cover the cost of the specified education program, credited directly to their bank account.
